name: Great Gate
summary: The Great Gate marks the fortified pass leading from the arid Barrens into the verdant tauren homeland of Mulgore. Anchored against sheer mountain ridges, this wooden bulwark ensures the security of the tribes and screens travelers entering their sacred plains.

sections.title: Threshold of Mulgore
sections.body: Carved through the towering peaks encircling Mulgore, this pass serves as the primary overland artery connecting the high grasslands to the wider world of the Barrens. Guarded vigilantly by tauren braves, the massive palisade wall and gatehouses keep aggressive quilboar tribes, centaur raiders, and hostile beast packs from wandering unchecked into the tribal pastures.

sections.title: A Shield for the Tribes
sections.body: Since the tauren unified under Cairne Bloodhoof and ended their long nomadic wandering across Kalimdor, maintaining secure borders has been essential. The Great Gate represents more than just a checkpoint; it symbolizes the hard-won peace and safety of the tauren nation, standing firm against whatever dangers stalk the dusty savannah beyond.

faq.answer: The gate spans the main pass connecting Mulgore to the Barrens. Passing through the archway takes travelers directly from the dusty central savannah into the lush, grassy heartland of the tauren tribes.

Braves and sentries of the tauren tribes stand watch over the gate and its adjacent ramparts. They monitor all traffic moving through the canyon to safeguard Thunder Bluff and the outlying villages from external threats.

The mountains naturally enclose Mulgore on nearly all sides, leaving only narrow gaps like this pass. Fortifying this chokepoint provides an effective shield against hostile quilboar, raiders, and wild predators that inhabit the Barrens.

angles.text: The gate marks the sacred threshold of your homeland, serving as the front line of defense protecting elders, youth, and grazing herds from the perils of Kalimdor.
For travelers coming from Orgrimmar or the crossroads of the Barrens, the Great Gate is the official welcoming point into the sovereign territory of the tauren allies.
